I hold an MSc in Global Studies. Politics, economics and sociology in a global perspective. Greece has long been my particular interest, and I wrote my thesis, *Prefiguration of Change: Social Solidarities in Athens* (2019), on social movements and solidarities in Greece. My primary academic and journalistic focus is contemporary Greek society, politics and economics.

## Migration and humanitarian work

From 2018 to 2023 I was a coordinator, researcher and editor at Are You Syrious, a news platform and NGO. The work covered global migration politics, international relations and the humanitarian field, in an international team, and included the coordination of volunteers.

## Management and consultancy

I have broad experience in operational management and as a consultant and project manager, covering line management, project and change management, and consultancy, and broad experience in coaching and mentoring. I am experienced in LEAN management, including as a lead auditor of LEAN management and production. I am certified in IPMA and PRINCE2 project management and in change management, and I have worked in multicultural and international environments. My experience also covers warehouse management, team development, planning and strategy.

## Short biography

For editors and organisers who need a biography in the third person:

::: {.bio-third-person}
Mads Henrik Højgaard is a Danish researcher and analyst of contemporary Greek society, politics and economics. He holds an MSc in Global Studies from Roskilde University (RUC), where he wrote his thesis on social movements and solidarities in Athens, Greece. From 2018 to 2023 he was a coordinator, researcher and editor at the news platform and NGO Are You Syrious, working on global migration politics and the humanitarian field. He also has a broad background in operational management and as a consultant and project manager, certified in IPMA, PRINCE2 and change management.
:::
